subject: Commit cleanout: Apex Health - action items & save-play
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Commit cleanout: Apex Health - action items & save-play

Team —

Running the weekly commit cleanout and Apex Health popped as a mid-quarter risk. I attached a short commit sheet (Apex_Health_commit_review_0629.xlsx) and a draft MAP (RW-MAP-Apex-0629.pdf). Quick summary and asks below:

Snapshot:
- ARR: $420k TCV target (closed-won expected Q3)
- Current stage: Negotiation
- Risk band (preliminary): YELLOW (procurement timeline slipping)

Immediate asks (owners & due dates):
1) Stage confirmation + red/yellow/green assignment — owners: Grace + Marissa — due EOD Wed 6/30
2) Procurement gating checklist — owner: Vivek — confirm if PO required, legal redlines outstanding, and SOC 2 evidence list — due Thu 7/1
3) One-page MAP to send to customer with clear next steps and dates — owner: Chloe — draft by Tue 6/30 noon; send to Jamie after internal sign-off

Save-play options to consider (prioritized):
- Short-term credit (1 month) to cover initial pilot ramp — low friction, needs Exec approval
- Shipment of trial quota with conditional invoice on PO submission — needs billing alignment
- Fast-track technical kickoff slot (priority onboarding) — owned by CS (I will loop them once we commit to MAP)

Please update the attached sheet directly (column: "Owner notes") and flag any items you want me to escalate. I will compile a short email to Jamie with the MAP once we have internal alignment.

Thanks,
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

--
Attachments: Apex_Health_commit_review_0629.xlsx, RW-MAP-Apex-0629.pdf
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 29 Jun 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Commit cleanout: Apex Health - action items & save-play

Thanks Chloe — looked through the sheet. Quick notes:
- I agree with Yellow; procurement has asked for a SOC 2 snapshot and data residency confirmation which we don't have on file for this champion yet.
- Marissa: can you confirm PO cadence with customer finance? They mentioned "end of month" but that might mean end of July.
- Vivek: SOC 2 evidence + KMS note are blockers for procurement; if you can surface a short artifact list we can fast-track the request with them.

Proposed internal play: send a tight MAP with 3 milestone dates (Tech kickoff, PO submission, Pilot start). Add optional 1-month credit to MAP as an incentive — I'll pre-approve up to $10k credit if Finance signs off.

On the sheet I added comments in rows 4-7.

- Grace

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Jamie Porter <jamie@apexhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: RW MAP & next steps — Apex Health pilot (draft)

Jamie —

Thanks again for the great conversation last week. Per our internal review, we want to make sure we remove friction on your side and set clear, achievable milestones so Apex can get value quickly. Attached is a short mutual action plan (RW-MAP-Apex-0629.pdf) and a one-line summary of options we can take to accelerate procurement.

Proposed MAP highlights (requested confirmation):
- Tech kickoff: target week of 7/12 (Redwood provides 2-hour onboarding session)
- PO submission: target by 7/20 (Apex procurement)
- Pilot live: target week of 7/26

We can include a 1-month usage credit (applied to initial invoice) if Apex signs MAP and submits PO by 7/20. If procurement needs a formal SOC 2 snapshot, our security team will provide the artifact; Vivek (cc'd) can confirm exact docs.

Can you confirm: a) PO timing, b) whether procurement needs the SOC 2 artifact or additional legal language, and c) whether 7/12 kickoff looks reasonable? If procurement wants to be on the kickoff call, feel free to loop them in (I included procurement@apexhealth.com below as an example).

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if that's easier.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: RW-MAP-Apex-0629.pdf
From: Jamie Porter <jamie@apexhealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Apex Procurement <procurement@apexhealth.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: RW MAP & next steps — Apex Health pilot (draft)

Chloe —

Appreciate the clear MAP. Quick responses from our side:
- Procurement: target PO by 7/22 (they requested a few days after the finance review)
- SOC 2: procurement will accept the SOC 2 Type II snapshot and a short note on data residency; please have Vivek send those artifacts to procurement@apexhealth.com by 7/6 so we can include them in the review packet.
- Tech kickoff: 7/12 works for our engineering lead (please keep it to 60–90 minutes). Procurement indicated they do not need to attend kickoff but may join the follow-up invoice/PO sync.

The 1-month credit is helpful and will speed approval. I'll confirm internally and aim to have the PO submitted on or around 7/22.

Thanks — Jamie
Director of Digital Transformation
Apex Health
